name: role
label: Role
help: Role for the invited people, one of admin, editor, analyst, viewer, billing or custom. Default viewer. Use custom together with custom_role_id. Owner cannot be invited.

name: all_sites
label: All Sites
help: true (default) gives access to every site including future ones. Set false to limit access to site_ids.

name: site_ids
label: Sites
help: The sites they may open. Only used when All Sites is false.
